label: origins
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: THREE separate tall portrait game backgrounds arranged as equal-width columns side by side, without gutters, frames or dividing rules. Each portrait is approximately 1:2.16, overall canvas approximately 3:2.16. Create full rectangular paintings, NOT icons. The supplied images are style/continuity references: luminous opaque gouache, selective fine ink, lapis, jade, burnt ochre, muted coral, warm ivory light. Monumental and intimate, a world being created, never a settlement. No text, numbers, words, ornamental borders, people unless explicitly specified, buildings, UI or watermark. Place dramatic landmarks mainly in the UPPER 42 percent of EACH portrait; the LOWER 58 percent must be a spacious calm medium-LIGHT desaturated blue-grey/ochre painted foreground with sparse broad atmospheric strokes, giving dark circular tokens readable working space. This calm area belongs naturally to each painting, not a rectangular UI panel or flat overlay. Preserve the three equal portrait panels. LEFT: Before creation. Abstract deep ultramarine emptiness, subtle hand-painted mineral-pigment atmosphere, a faint broad ivory-blue haze near the lower working area. NO stars, sun, moon, planet, rocks, plants, animals, figures or outlined objects. The quiet empty canvas is the invitation. CENTER: A majestic complete spiral GALAXY high in the frame, two bright ivory-gold arms turning through lapis space with a sparse surrounding starfield. Vast luminous depth, not a planet or a whirlpool. Its light dissolves toward the calm pale indigo working space below. RIGHT: A new stellar nursery after an older star has scattered its matter. Great interweaving jade, ivory and ochre dust clouds high in space with several dense dark knots beginning to glow softly from within; no planets, no single finished solar system. Dust curtains settle into quiet blue-grey empty space below.
